title_en: Visions of the Future (4/20): The Road to the Afterlife
note_en: 不是…而是… means "not X but Y" and is used to correct an assumption: 死亡并不是终点，而是通往另一个世界的开始 "death was not the end but the beginning of a journey to another world." Adding 并 before 不是 makes the denial more emphatic, like English "not at all." The same pattern returns in 死亡不是令人恐惧的事情，而是一场值得提前认真准备的旅程.
